items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: We were covering a lot of stuff: James Brown, Otis Redding, you know we played some Joe Tex.

ctx.x: Did you have aspirations, as most bands do, of like, “Let’s make a record. Let’s get a deal.”

Well the thing was, it’s funny you said that. We were sort of a cover band. We didn’t really write a lot of originals. We were covering a lot of stuff: James Brown, Otis Redding, you know we played some Joe Tex. We were doing a lot of covers. So I don’t think we really dreamed too much about having a record deal. And then finally we did write some songs. We got a one deal thing with Mercury. I had a band called Giant and we did one album. And I wrote most of the stuff. But we weren’t thinking original songs, and…

Did you have an option of another line of work? Because last night I heard you saying that you know I just worked weekends, it never occurred to me that I might make a living. I might be extrapolating on what you said, but was there another option for you?
